'''Barnaban mist-pudding''' was a dessert dish<ref name="LE" /> created on the planet [[Barnaba]]<ref name="Planetnamia" /> in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="LE" /> Barnaban mist-pudding was served aboard the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] [[Gem of Alderaan]]<ref name="GA">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref> and at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
